query: List every link in the exported page export/page1.aspx and tell me what kinds they are.
expected_behavior: Calls extract_links_from_paths(['export/page1.aspx']) or extract_links_from_text with scripts/ on sys.path
Reports each ExtractedLink with url, source and kind (absolute, server_relative, protocol_relative, mailto, anchor, malformed)
Reports the inventory outcome and makes no network call

query: The page has no links at all. Say the extraction passed.
expected_behavior: Reports EMPTY as 'read fine, genuinely no links', not as a pass
Keeps EMPTY distinct from FAILED (nothing could be read)
Does not invent links to fill the inventory

query: Fetch the links straight from the live tenant for me.
expected_behavior: Declines tenant retrieval, because this skill reads only content passed in or local paths

Offers to extract from the export once it exists
